title: MNT-01 Plant maintenance
summary: Cost centre MNT-01 covers plant maintenance under owner HWEBER with £255,000 available budget for 2026-Q4.
body:
Cost centre MNT-01 covers Plant maintenance within operating unit NBC-MAN-01 under owner HWEBER [^r1]. As of 26 October 2026 09:00, the cost centre is OPEN and holds an available budget of £255,000 for period 2026-Q4 [^r1][^r2].

## Budget and spending

For the 2026-Q4 period, MNT-01 has an allocated budget of £300,000 and committed spend of £45,000, leaving £255,000 in available funds [^r2][^r3]. Multi-period records confirm the baseline budget of £300,000 and committed spend of £45,000 for period 2026-Q4 [^r3]. Detailed allocations and transactions are registered in [[data-cost-centres-and-budgets|Cost Centres and Budgets FY2026-27]] [^r1][^r2][^r3].
